mentions.name: Baduk Teacher
mentions.description: This service makes Go (the board game) lessons possible across different languages, connecting Western students with pro-level teachers in Korea, China, Japan and Taiwan. It uses Go-specific domain translation to remove the language barrier, making high-level Go teaching accessible to players who don't share a language with their teacher.
mentions.problem: The West has limited access to pro-level Go teachers because most pro-level teachers in Asia do not speak or read foreign languages such as English, creating a language barrier that keeps high-level Go teaching inaccessible to Western players.
mentions.audience: The Western Go community: foreign Go enthusiasts and players who want access to high-level Go teaching to improve their game.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Baduk Teacher, which makes having Go lessons (the board game) across different languages possible.
